name: spear_hew1

authoring.method: hand-keyed F-curves on control properties, solved by Python (FK in the runtime overlay's arithmetic, two-bone arm and leg solves); no motion capture, no video-to-motion

axes: skeleton space, Z up. Stance frame: right = left thigh to right thigh (flat), front = up x right. Turn: yaw positive toward the character's left (about up), pitch about the stance right (positive tips a standing segment back), roll about the stance front (positive tips it to the right); composed yaw, pitch, roll about the bone's own origin. Aim: azimuth from the stance front toward its right, elevation above the horizontal (absolute). Move/Foot: forward, right, up metres in the stance frame.

rest_pose.note: the base stance the keys lie over (hips 71 degrees right of the facing); a bone with no track at the skeleton's reference pose; keys are valid over any loop phase of the idle

timing.source: the hammer's X1 SM_MEL_TH_XATK_Combo2 2.667 s, hit 0.604 s at the spear's tempo 0.85
